title: Senior Radar Systems Engineer - Defense & Space Manufacturing

cond_0001.intro: [Company name masked] is seeking a multi-faceted Radar Systems Engineer to support all phases of radar system development, integration, and testing. They will perform radar analysis and simulation and help develop radar system-level and subsystem-level requirements. In addition, the Engineer will provide technical guidance for subsystem development and implementation and provide support for system integration and testing. Excellent communication skills are required, as the ability to support customer relations and management reporting requirements is essential. The Engineer will be an integral part of the team and the projects they will support.
cond_0001.responsibilities: The Senior Radar Systems Engineer will support our subsidiary located in [Location masked]. We support DoD and [Location masked] customers by planning, implementing, and testing systems and software for advanced radar and threat simulator systems. We specialize in the development of advanced radar systems and radar related products for the Department of Defense and other [Location masked] Government agencies. Our radar programs involve all phases of development from requirements generation through hardware and software design, fabrication, integration, and test.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Active Department of Defense (DoD) Secret security clearance.
BS degree in Electrical Engineering, Mathematics or Physics.
Experience in radar systems, including: Radar and radar-related concepts such as the Doppler effect, detection theory, tracking, digital signal processing (FFT, IIR/FIR filtering, etc.), waveform generation, receiver design, and antenna theory.
Use of MATLAB for analysis or simulation.
System-level and/or subsystem-level requirements and specifications.
Systems integration and test.
Preferred Requirements
Familiarity with RF, analog, digital, or microwave hardware design.
Use of test equipment such as oscilloscopes, spectrum analyzers, etc.
Expert level proficiency in MATLAB.
Familiarity with software development, C++, and Linux operating systems.
MS degree in Electrical Engineering, Physics, or Systems Engineering.

Active Department of Defense (DoD) Secret security clearance.
BS degree in Electrical Engineering, Mathematics or Physics.
Experience in radar systems, including: Radar and radar-related concepts such as the Doppler effect, detection theory, tracking, digital signal processing (FFT, IIR/FIR filtering, etc.), waveform generation, receiver design, and antenna theory.
Use of MATLAB for analysis or simulation.
System-level and/or subsystem-level requirements and specifications.
Systems integration and test.

Familiarity with RF, analog, digital, or microwave hardware design.

MS degree in Electrical Engineering, Physics, or Systems Engineering.
